text:
maya: ok team quick watercooler game — write a 1-line GPT-style bio for the office fern (LLM vibes only). keep it spicy. go!
jamal: Fern-7B — pretrained on windowsill light, fine-tuned on vibes. forgets to drink water but remembers your secrets. :fern: :laughing:
lena: HouseplantGPT v1 — outputs humidity forecasts and passive-aggressive reminders to water at 3am. :alarm_clock:
emily: Photosyn-XL — 3.2B parameters, 0.2B naps, always optimizing for optimal leaf tilt. :leafy_green:
tom: ChlorophyllNet — low latency leaf-turning, highest accuracy on sunlight-to-growth ratio. occasionally hallucinate new leaves. :thinking_face:
chris: SilentObserver-GPT — only responds with dramatic leaf droop. strong on subtlety. :zipper_mouth_face:
rachel: My personal fav: FernOfMystery-Deep — trained on podcasts and indie coffee shop playlists. outputs cryptic fortune-cookie care tips. :crystal_ball:
emily: also imagine the fern has a README: \n``\nREADME: do not overwater. will judge your ad-hoc standups. responds to kind compliments.\n```
jamal: office-bot: poll: Which model would you adopt as your desk roommate? options: Fern-7B / Photosyn-XL / ChlorophyllNet / SilentObserver-GPT / FernOfMystery-Deep
office-bot: poll created (24h) — vote with :one: - :five:
chris: betting on Photosyn-XL winning because Tom keeps naming things with XL. :seedling:
lena: @tom please stop naming everything XL, it hurts my lunch choices. :pleading_face:
maya: love this. new tradition? every Friday plant model roast? :thumbsup:
tom: yes. next week: coffee machine as an enthusiastically unreliable recommender system. :coffee: :robot_face:
emily: someone actually should write tiny model cards for all office appliances. imagine 'Microwave-Mini: seq2seq of popcorn pop times' lol
rachel: also posting at 2pm to the #general memes channel when the poll is tallied. prepare yourselves. :sunglasses:
jamal: will bring snacks to bribe the fern into voting. :chocolate_bar: :wink:
